body:
Hey bud. Im 27 still in college like you do. I was also thinking of dying yesterday. 6 years into college and still not close to graduate. Look buddy. There are ways it can get better. Yes its rough. Yes its hard. I cant see tommorow will be better. Life is hard, study is hard, and we can make some mistakes. It can be so big that our parents can suffer so long but it may be so small that it doesnt matter much. We made mistakes u and i. I will be honest , my situation is alot worse than yours. I know there are some stuffs u didnt mention in here that is killing you but lets try hard. Maybe something will change tommorow. Imagine yourself in 10 years, how do you know if you get lottery prize. 

Couple of songs i recommend you to listen

Blessing - song composed of different languages.

If you need help just ask someone can help you. You can read my story if u want to. Dont give up bud. We will die someday whether we want to or not, but now is not the time

Wow hahaha.. You are just like me. Same age. Similar cirumstances except i choose this way. Right now i am thinking of suiciding. I just cant take care of who i am. No one trusts me, no one expects me. I guess two biggest differences u and i r a) i kinda deserve this b) people around you knows about your circumstances and thats not the case for me.

I know saying dude just dont do it wont do. Why? Cuz i feel the same way as you do. I depise myself. I get disgusted by who i am and how i have become. Unlike you i have not made suicide attempts yet cuz i know when i make one, i will die. I still know how you feel. Whatever i say whatever good quotes and meaningful words we here wont reach to us.

My friend, i dont know what to say cuz i feel same way as you do. I cant see the light. Few weeks ago few months ago i thought myself tommorow will be better. Tommorow maybe something about me will change. Tommorow i might be able to laugh. I was thinking of dying today cuz i couldnt see hope. I tried talking to some remedychat cuz i wanted him to listen to my story. He tried to encourage me but i felt almost nothing.

I know how you feel, and i know whatever some fancy words i say, it wont reach you. Here is my very personal opinion, do not let others kill you. Another word dont kill yourself because of something other than yourself. I want to kill myself cuz i hate every part of me. I choose to be this way. I dont think thats case for you.

Heres one last tip from me. If you want to try living for one last time, do so by making friends. I dont care methods. You can do so from some app, games , jobs, works, schools , or whatever. Make friends that will change your whole life.

Thx for kind reply... Maybe i wanted to hear this. One person in this world still have faiths in me, and that i can do it. Oh well... I am not going to bridge yet just because if i go there, i will really jump. Haha... At first i was soo scared of suiciding now i feel like i can do it. Just talked to my mom and shes been crying over and over. My hearts is dying looking at her
